WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country
), average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entry_count
  FROM race_totals
)
SELECT rt.raceId, rt.country, rt.total_points, rt.entry_count,
       rt.entry_count - ac.avg_entry_count AS above_average
FROM race_totals AS rt
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE rt.entry_count > ac.avg_entry_count
ORDER BY above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
